changes.title: Sigil holograms
items: Every soundsystem now projects its area's animal sigil into the sky as a flickering hologram over the treetops, in place of its lasers; it glitches when the soundsystem is hurt and folds away when it falls

changes.title: Light rings
items: Seen from the treetops, faint rings of moonlight shimmer on the crowns here and there, slowly breathing outward

changes.title: Dream thought bubbles
items: A sleeping legend's dream is now a pixel thought bubble: little clouds rising to a big one, showing one thing at a time (its face, the creature it dreams of, and now and then the relic flask)

changes.title: Slashes grid
items: Her claw slashes now sit on the game's own pixel grid, each pixel the same size as the forest's
